Take Command with the KIOTI DK5020MB

Powerful. Dependable. Ready to Work.

The KIOTI DK5020MB is built for landowners and professionals who need performance they can count on. This 50-horsepower, 4WD compact utility tractor combines power, durability, and versatility in a rugged design. Whether you’re moving dirt, lifting, digging, or operating attachments, the DK5020MB is up for the task with a proven manual transmission and reliable diesel engine.

Features May Include:

  • 50 HP Diesel Engine
    A fuel-efficient, high-performance engine with excellent torque and reliability.

  • Manual Transmission
    8 forward and 8 reverse gears give you control and power for every job.

  • Power Steering
    Reduces operator fatigue with smooth, responsive steering.

  • 4WD Capability
    Push through tough terrain with selectable four-wheel drive.

  • Deluxe Operator Station
    Comfortable seating, easy-to-reach controls, and clear visibility for long workdays.

  • Hydraulic Power
    High-capacity hydraulics make operating attachments effortless and efficient.

  • Rear PTO
    Standard rear PTO for running mowers, tillers, and more.

  • Lift Capacity
    Strong 3-point hitch lift capacity lets you handle heavy implements with ease.

  • Durable Construction
    Built with a heavy-duty frame and steel components to handle real work.
